The {5} hooks of such a handler run for the requests it responds to, and not for its WebSocket upgrade request. The h3 v1 body readers, such as {6}, reject a {7} request with {8}. Requests made in process, such as a server-side {9} call to one of your own routes, get an {10} whose {11} is {12}. The {13}Nuxt 5 upgrade guide{/13} lists the helpers.
